style_guide.lighting: Soft natural indoor daylight with believable room shadows; no studio glow.
style_guide.camera_style: Grounded real-camera perspective, mostly rear three-quarter and controlled cutaway views.
style_guide.environment: Ordinary compact home kitchen; realistic wall clearance and everyday surfaces.
style_guide.color_notes: Neutral household colors; refrigerator remains matte white.

entities.name: Canonical refrigerator
entities.canonical_description: Matte white freestanding two-door top-freezer refrigerator in an ordinary home kitchen, viewed initially from a rear three-quarter angle.
invariant_features: same kitchen environment when the physical object is visible
allowed_variations: rear/side camera rotation consistent with the same object
forbidden_variations: change to French-door or side-by-side layout
replace with a different refrigerator model
move to an unrelated kitchen without a context switch
alter component locations merely for visual convenience
continuity_constraints: All physical refrigerator scenes must derive from A1 or an approved derivative.
Technical abstractions should preserve the recognizable fridge_01 silhouette when shown together with the appliance.
Scene 5 may compare heat-rejection layouts but must keep fridge_01 as the primary example.

global_continuity_rules: fridge_01 must never be independently regenerated after A1 is approved.
All physical refrigerator visuals derive from A1 or an approved derivative.
Door layout, body color, proportions and kitchen context remain invariant.
Invisible processes use overlays/diagrams/programmatic animation, not fantastical photorealistic effects.
